objective: Preregister the single risk_score feature-IC candidate (RISK01) for dir:text_to_pit_feature_extraction's cheapest falsification pilot, before any DeepSeek score or IC number is computed. Universe capped to a fixed-seed 50-ticker x 8-quarter (400 filing-quarter) panel per the brief.

parameters.universe_sampling: Fixed-seed random.Random(20260928).sample(...) of 50 tickers from the 1146 tickers with an 'ok'-fetch-status 8-K in ALL 8 of the preregistered quarters, chosen before any DeepSeek call. 50*8=400 filing-quarters exactly, matching the brief's target.
parameters.rationale: Structured risk-label extraction on an 8-K panel, added as one feature; source: Dolphin et al. arxiv 2601.15247 (methodology), Choi et al. arxiv 2510.03195 (evidence LLM-structured disclosure features beat a baseline), see direction-review.json.

data_v1_h20260928_17_8k_sip.universe: fixed-seed random.Random(20260928).sample of 50 tickers from the 1146 tickers with a fetchable 8-K in all 8 of 2024Q3..2026Q2
data_v1_h20260928_17_8k_sip.confirmed_coverage: 1146 tickers confirmed present in all 8 quarters via pandas groupby on 2026-09-28; 50*8=400 filing-quarters by construction.

feature_v1_h20260928_17_risk_score.definition: Per (ticker, filing-quarter): DeepSeek reads the neutralised 8-K EX-99.1 text and returns risk_score in [0,1] (0=no material risk/uncertainty language, 1=major disclosed risk/uncertainty) plus risk_direction (up/same/down vs a general sense of typical disclosure, best-effort, not used in the primary feature). The feature value for a (ticker, quarter) is that quarter's single 8-K's risk_score (one filing per ticker per quarter, matching the quarterly 2.02 earnings cadence); visible_at = acceptance_utc + scoring latency, used for the PIT join, see tests/test_h20260928_17_filing_risk_labels.py.

label_v1_h20260928_17_forward_20d_return.definition: close-to-close forward 20-trading-day return from the day after the 8-K's acceptance date's open to 20 trading days later (close signal at filing acceptance, next_bar_open fill, matching the frozen project convention).

validation_v1_h20260928_17_ic_and_placeb.placebo: shuffle each filing's ticker assignment across tickers within the same filing quarter, recompute the identical feature pipeline, recompute IC
validation_v1_h20260928_17_ic_and_placeb.zoo_lift_check: attempted if the existing factor-zoo ranking pipeline is quick to reuse; standalone-only reported otherwise, disclosed either way

cost_v1_h20260928_17_no_cost_ic_only.definition: No cost model -- this pilot computes a feature and its IC only, no positions, no trades, no backtest.

benchmark_v1_h20260928_17_placebo_compar.definition: Real feature's rank IC vs the mismatched-filings placebo's rank IC, both vs forward 20-day returns; standalone IC and (if computed) zoo-added IC lift.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: Single candidate; no multiple-comparisons correction applicable (n_trials=1). This pilot does not compute or report a Sharpe/DSR -- it is an IC-only feature check.

keep_rule.pass_condition: Mean rank IC across the panel has a stable sign (>=60% of quarters/observations share the mean's sign) AND the placebo's mean |IC| is <50% of the real mean |IC| (same sign).
keep_rule.fail_condition: Either condition fails -> stop before scaling (direction-review.json stop_condition).
